h1: Psalm 91 Prayer for Sleep: Rest in the Shadow of the Almighty
meta_description: Read and hear Psalm 91 at bedtime with whispered Scripture readings. A nightly practice for quiet rest with no trial and no surprise charges.
direct_answer: A Psalm 91 prayer for sleep is a nightly practice of reading or listening to the words of Psalm 91 to quiet the mind before bed. It involves dwelling on the secret place of the most High and abiding under the shadow of the Almighty until peace covers your room.

sections.heading: How to read Psalm 91 before bed
paragraphs: The night brings quiet hours, but it also brings heavy thoughts. You turn the pillow over. You watch the shadows on the ceiling. You need a place to rest your mind before sleep takes you. Reading the Bible at bedtime brings a gentle stillness to the room. You do not need to rush through the pages. You can take your time with the words.

Listen to how the Scripture begins in the King James Version. Psalm 91, verse one: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty. Those words carry a steady weight. You can whisper them into the dark. You can let the sound of the King James text fill your ears as you pull the blankets up. It is a simple way to let go of the day.

Many women find that hearing the text read softly helps settle a busy spirit. You might close your eyes and listen to whispered Bible readings. You can find more thoughts on this in Prayer for sleep: short prayers to pray tonight. The app includes the whole King James Bible to read and to hear, so you always have access to the text when the house grows dark and sleep is slow to come.
bullets: Read the text word for word from the King James Version.
Whisper the verses aloud into the quiet room.

sections.heading: Whispered Psalms for night hours
paragraphs: When you wake up in the middle of the night, the house is still. The dark feels deep. Instead of reaching for a screen that glows with bright lights, you can turn on soft audio. Peace Be Still offers whispered Psalms for sleep with a sleep timer called Psalm Nights. The voice stays low and unhurried. It does not demand your attention. It simply reads the text while you drift back toward rest.

You might hear Psalm 91, verse five: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day. Hearing these words spoken in a gentle whisper reminds you that you are kept safe. The sleep timer lets the audio fade away on its own. You do not have to worry about turning it off after you drift away.

This nightly practice requires no effort from you. You simply lie down and listen. The app provides a calm space for your bedtime routine. It is built for quiet moments when you want nothing more than the plain text of Scripture and a restful voice to guide your thoughts until morning comes.
bullets: Use the built-in sleep timer for nighttime listening.
Hear whispered Psalms without loud music or distractions.

sections.heading: Bible chat and daily declarations
paragraphs: Sometimes questions linger in your mind long after the lights go out. You might wonder about a specific verse or how a passage applies to your life. The app features Bible chat that is AI, labelled as AI, quoting KJV verses word for word. You can ask questions and receive answers drawn straight from the text without human opinions getting in the way.

Each morning brings a fresh start. You can open the app to find a daily Bible story. In Hush Harbor, you will discover Bible stories told in a Black church voice. These narratives bring familiar accounts to life in a warm and personal way, connecting your heritage to the ancient text.

You can also spend time with Mi Refugio: Biblia y chat en español con la Reina-Valera 1909. Spanish-speaking families can read, listen, and chat using a translation they know and love. Every feature is designed to keep you close to the Word throughout the day and deep into the night.

faq.q: Can I listen to Psalm 91 on a timer?
faq.a: Yes, you can listen to whispered Psalms for sleep using the built-in sleep timer called Psalm Nights. The audio will gently fade away on its own after you set the timer, allowing you to drift off to sleep without needing to turn your phone off manually.

faq.q: Are there ads or surprise trial fees?
faq.a: No, there are no ads anywhere on the platform and there is no free trial period. You can use the free lane forever at no cost, or choose the paid lane for $7.99 a month or $39.99 a year with zero hidden charges.

faq.q: What Bible translation is used for English readers?
faq.a: English readers have access to the entire King James Version to read and to hear. Every verse quoted in the AI Bible chat and whispered audio readings comes directly from this trusted and traditional text word for word.
